title: Verbal report from the Department of Water and Power and Bureau of Sanitation on Pure Water Los Angeles—a joint effort to create a new and sustainable…
text: Verbal report from the Department of Water and Power and Bureau of Sanitation on Pure Water Los Angeles—a joint effort to create a new and sustainable supply of drinking water by purifying recycled water, supporting the transition to a reliable and more resilient local water supply.
summary: The Department of Water and Power and the Bureau of Sanitation will report on Pure Water Los Angeles, a joint effort to turn recycled water into a new local source of drinking water.
